checks: Independent light, grey/cloud-foreground, and dark/rain art load; observation changes neither actual ship layers nor gun commands; distance references remain identical across layers
Zoom preserves the 50 metre cell and 500/5000 metre references; panning moves world-anchored coordinate labels by the exact screen offset
Actual shells keep their upper-layer identity while observing rain; rain moves visibly during battle, freezes on pause, and off-layer clicks cannot fire into the wrong layer
Default 1280 by 860 desktop layout keeps layer controls, distance legend and the fitted battlefield available without horizontal page overflow
Reset destroys the canvas and art without a remaining battle animation; a fresh scene still supports observation and camera controls when image resources fail
scope: Real prepared battle currently deploys both ships in upper layer; simultaneous three-layer picking and fixed projectile layer semantics are additionally checked in unit tests.
